source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/README.md §0.4 'State note strip'; ruling 2.6 (exact geometry, restated verbatim from the README); 'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' p15's neutral state note ('Applies workspace-wide')
notes: StateNote.tsx is pure inline style; every property here is a real product value.

Ruling 2.6: 'border-left 3px solid <band>; background <band tint>; border-radius 0 6px 6px 0; padding 9px 12px. Left side straight. Neutral variant #5A5552 on #F5F2EE.' '#5A5552' is the `--brand` token, NOT `--ink-2` (#5A6B67) — StateNote.tsx's neutral variant uses `band ? ... : 'var(--ink-2)'`, i.e. the wrong token for the neutral border-left colour (background is correct, `--tag` = #F5F2EE).
